lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Canada’s new partnership with the European Union is meant to provide benefits to people on both continents, The Canadian Press reports.
The federal government has listed the Port of Vancouver’s planned Roberts Bank Terminal 2 expansion as a project of national interest, The Canadian Press reports.

The CEO of a Toronto real estate services company has released a statement following Thursday’s violent home invasion that left him and other members of his family injured, saying it was a “terrifying and life-threatening experience,” The Canadian Press reports.
Crypto giant Binance attempting to recover $6.3bn stolen in hack linked to North Korea, BBC News reports.

Evacuees from Russian-occupied Oleshky began the long journey out of the war-ravaged region in bus convoys Friday, on the fourth day of the most significant truce since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine four-and-a-half years ago, The Canadian Press reports.
ICE officer charged in Texas after allegedly hitting man with vehicle, CBS News reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
